messages:
deploy-bot: Plan: staggered enable of model `tiling-lyra-q2` into model catalog (eu-west-1). Canary slices: 0.5% -> 2% -> 8%. Each step holds 20m. Change window: 2026-03-23T01:00Z - 2026-03-23T03:00Z. Rollback TTL 10m. Circuit-breaker on error rate & latency. Notifying #oncall and ops-bot. :satellite:
tom: Copy. I'll own the canary perf checks and the canary prompt set. Thresholds: p50 <= 130ms, p95 <= 260ms, error <= 0.6%.
priya: Recommend route-level pin for high-traffic routes: /chat-stream, /summary. Keep pinned to `lyra-stable` until 8% is healthy. Avoid silent swap at low percents.
hana: Agreed. Also add fallback ladder: tiling-lyra-q2 -> tiling-lyra-q1 -> base-13b. Document fallback ordering in release notes.
luke: Ops note: I'll enable a short-lived quota bump for canary to prevent throttles interfering with results. Also set cost alert at +20% per-req.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 started -> 0.5% routing applied. Canary id: cb-505432. Telemetry: latency_watcher, cost_watcher, safety-hook.
tom: Running smoke set `tiling_canary_2026-03-23`. Posting results in ~12m.
ops-bot: Reminder: if circuit-breaker trips, deploy-bot will auto-roll back after TTL unless ops ack.
priya: Smoke quicks: p50 128ms, p95 240ms, errors 0.2%, cost +9%. All green for 0.5%. Proceed to 2%.
deploy-bot: Expanding canary to 2%. Route pins remain for /chat-stream,/summary.
luke: Seeing slight increase in p99 tail on a small subset of routes, investigating if client retries spike. No global error increase yet.
hana: Keep watch. If p95 climbs >15% from baseline or client retries increase across regions, we rollback.
tom: 2% hold 20m: metrics stable. p50 132ms, p95 245ms, errors 0.25%. Proceed to 8% per plan.
priya: Before 8% go, ops: ensure pin removal checklist ready. We'll unpin only after steady 1h at 8%.
luke: Confirmed. Dashboard widgets pushed: canary_latency_delta, canary_error_rate, canary_cost. Alerts wired.
deploy-bot: Expanding to 8% now. Expect routing convergence in ~60s.
tom: During 8% ramp, observed one brief spike from a partner region (ap-south) causing retries. Peak error 0.9% for 3m then recovered. Degraded but isolated.
hana: Since it recovered and global error remained <0.6% overall, hold. If we see repeat, escalate to full rollback.
priya: Ops manual: rollback command for fast pin and cut traffic back -> `deploy-bot rollback --canary cb-505432 --force` and `api route pin set --routes "/chat-stream,/summary"`
